The review supports the draft’s P1–P6 dispositions. Its main finding is that ODK Entity Lists download all entities to devices and store properties as strings, which adds privacy and quantity-data constraints ([ODK documentation](https://docs.getodk.org/central-entities/)). Minor clarifications cover ERPNext’s Sales Order reservation scope ([pinned v15 code](https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/blob/26f06878346fb6861229ccb1fe3a53dc1bf5bad3/erpnext/stock/doctype/stock_reservation_entry/stock_reservation_entry.py)), WCAG’s web-content scope ([W3C Recommendation](https://www.w3.org/TR/2024/REC-WCAG22-20241212/)), and the missing exact source for the Field Kit v1 statement. The predecessor draft was left unchanged; proposed validations are marked unexecuted.
